description: Full-CRUD Adobe Experience Platform server: 46 tools for schemas, ingestion, profiles, audiences.
name: com.focusgts/aep

environmentVariables.description: Adobe I/O client ID from an OAuth Server-to-Server credential in the Adobe Developer Console.
environmentVariables.name: AEP_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Adobe I/O client secret paired with AEP_CLIENT_ID.
environmentVariables.name: AEP_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Adobe IMS organization ID, in the form xxxxxxxxx@AdobeOrg.
environmentVariables.name: AEP_ORG_ID

environmentVariables.description: AEP sandbox to scope every call to. Defaults to 'prod'. Use a development sandbox to enable write operations.
environmentVariables.name: AEP_SANDBOX_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Write posture: 'read-only' (no mutation anywhere), 'safe' (default — writes only in sandboxes Adobe classifies as development), or 'production' (writes anywhere). Reads are never restricted.
environmentVariables.name: AEP_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Pino log level. Logs go to stderr; stdout is reserved for the MCP JSON-RPC stream.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
